place_fields.summary: Tunga River Front Park is a riverside promenade and green space in Shivamogga, with a walking/jogging path, greenery, murals/sculptures, children's play area and outdoor exercise facilities.

planning_attributes.description: The park is described as a riverside recreational space suited to walking, jogging, cycling, family outings and photography.
planning_attributes.how_to_reach: Address listings place it on 1st Cross Kote Road in KR Puram, Shivamogga.
planning_attributes.safety_notes: Water-edge areas require ordinary caution and supervision of children.
planning_attributes.notes: Public listings report the park as open 24 hours; visitor density can increase on weekends and holidays.

place_fields.summary: Vidyanagara Flyover is a road flyover in Shivamogga's Vidyanagara area; reporting identifies it as the Vidyanagara flyover project and places it on the NH 13 corridor.
place_fields.best_time: daylight, if viewing as an urban landmark

planning_attributes.description: The flyover is transportation infrastructure rather than a conventional visitor attraction.
planning_attributes.how_to_reach: It is in the Vidyanagara area of Shivamogga; approach using the surrounding road network rather than stopping on the flyover.
planning_attributes.access_restrictions: Do not stop or walk on the traffic structure unless specifically permitted.
planning_attributes.safety_notes: Treat the flyover as active road infrastructure and observe traffic restrictions.
planning_attributes.notes: Public reporting confirms the Vidyanagara flyover in Shivamogga and its construction on the NH 13 road.
